title: ShinyHunters-Associated Vishing Group Linked to New INCEPTION Data Leak Site
description: The INCEPTION threat cluster, formerly linked to the ShinyHunters extortion group, conducts voice phishing (vishing) attacks to harvest credentials and bypass multi-factor authentication using social engineering. Active since March 2026, it targets sectors such as technology, healthcare, finance, and hospitality. The group uses over 70 legal-themed phishing domains mimicking legitimate identity providers like Okta to deliver targeted phishing content. Stolen data previously appeared on the ShinyHunters leak site and now surfaces on the new INCEPTION platform. The group claims independence but acknowledges tactical inspiration from ShinyHunters.
